sanctuary_sites: CNS (mandatory prophylaxis/treatment in intensive regimens due to high CNS involvement/relapse risk)

biomarkers.name: MYC rearrangement (t(8;14) IGH-MYC most common; also t(2;8) and t(8;22))
biomarkers.clinical_use: Diagnostic hallmark. Note MYC rearrangement is NECESSARY but NOT sufficient — DLBCL and HGBL may also have MYC rearrangements; combined morphology + immunophenotype + FISH required

biomarkers.name: CD10+, BCL6+, BCL2- (or dim), CD20+, TdT-
biomarkers.clinical_use: Typical germinal-center phenotype. BCL2 is usually negative or only weakly positive; TdT negative helps distinguish from B-lymphoblastic leukaemia/lymphoma

biomarkers.name: EBV (EBER ISH)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Supports classification of endemic variant but is not by itself diagnostic

biomarkers.name: TCF3 / ID3 mutations
biomarkers.clinical_use: Characteristic recurrent alterations affecting tonic B-cell receptor/PI3K signaling; supportive but not required for diagnosis

biomarkers.name: CD19, CD22
biomarkers.clinical_use: B-cell antigens that may support consideration of CD19- or CD22-directed therapy in relapsed/refractory disease, although no standard Burkitt-specific biomarker indication is established

biomarkers.name: Tumour lysis risk assessment (LDH, uric acid, phosphate, potassium, creatinine)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Very high TLS risk — rasburicase and aggressive hydration/monitoring at induction

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Uniform medium-sized B cells with round nuclei, multiple nucleoli, and basophilic cytoplasm with lipid vacuoles; classical 'starry-sky' appearance from scattered tingible-body macrophages engulfing apoptotic cells
variants: endemic (equatorial Africa, EBV-associated, jaw/facial bone predilection)
histomorphological_subtype.grading: Extremely high proliferation index by definition

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: 'Starry sky' pattern reflects extremely rapid cell turnover with tingible-body macrophage response to apoptotic tumour cells
tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Diffuse sheets of monomorphic medium-sized cells with characteristic starry-sky pattern from macrophage response

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Germinal centre B cells (specifically dark zone centroblasts) with MYC translocation
cellular_states_and_lineage.developmental_lineage: Mesoderm — lymphoid (germinal centre dark zone B cells)
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Uniform medium-sized B cells with round nuclei, multiple nucleoli, and basophilic cytoplasm with lipid vacuoles; extremely high proliferation index (Ki-67 ~100%); classical 'starry-sky' from tingible-body macrophage response
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: MYC translocation to IGH (t(8;14), most common) or IGL/IGK (t(8;22), t(2;8)) drives uncontrolled proliferation via constitutive MYC expression; MYC has effects on both proliferation AND metabolism (Warburg-like glucose utilisation, glutaminolysis); TP53 and CDKN2A alterations can contribute to escape from MYC-triggered apoptosis; ID3 and TCF3 alterations are characteristic
